name: Fishar
summary: A fishing social network for iOS and Android. Share your catches, save your spots on the map and check the weather before heading out.
description: The social network for anglers: post your catches, pin the spots where they bite and check the weather before loading the rod in the car.

architecture.presentation: MapScreen reads mapSpotsProvider, a Riverpod AsyncNotifier. Widgets do not know Supabase exists.
architecture.domain: Pure Dart: GetSpotsUseCase depends on the IPostRepository interface and returns Either<Failure, T> with fpdart.
architecture.data: PostRepositoryImpl implements the contract on Supabase through PostRemoteDataSource and maps models to entities.

decisions.title: Errors as values
decisions.body: Use cases return Either<Failure, T> with a sealed Failure hierarchy: the UI decides what to show for each failure, with no scattered try/catch.

decisions.title: Supabase as the backend
decisions.body: Auth, PostgreSQL and Storage in a single service. Firebase is only used for push notifications.

decisions.title: Weather without a backend of its own
decisions.body: Hourly and daily forecasts come from Open-Meteo, which is for non-commercial use; the store listing says so and promises no accuracy.

mediaCaptions.feed: Feed: catches from the people you follow, with species, weight, length and bait.
mediaCaptions.mapa: Spots map, with catches grouped by place.
mediaCaptions.clima: Hourly and daily weather for the place you are going to fish.
mediaCaptions.nueva-captura: New post: the photo and, optionally, species, weight, length, bait and location.
mediaCaptions.perfil: Profile with posts, followers and the grid of catches.
